title: wx.json
description: Manifest for a wx package. Every wx compilation is rooted at a directory containing one of these.

type.description:
What kind of package this is.

- "bin": a binary package with an `export { .. }` block; compiles to a standalone .wasm module.
- "lib": a library package, depended on by other packages.
- "std": this package provides the standard library itself (the operator traits, `Memory`, etc). Only wx's own std package should use this — it means the embedded stdlib is not also loaded, not that no stdlib is used.

entry.description: Path to the entry source file, relative to this manifest's own directory. Never guessed from a conventional filename.

dependencies.description: Other local packages this package depends on, keyed by the name this package will know them as.

propertyNames.description: Must be a snake_case wx identifier and not a reserved keyword (e.g. not `loop`, `fn`, `if`, ...).

type.description: The dependency's source kind. Only "local" exists today.

path.description: Path to the dependency package's directory, relative to this manifest's own directory.

format.description: Formatter configuration for `wx format`. Every field is optional and falls back to the formatter's default when omitted.

max_line_width.description: Maximum line width the formatter will try to fit code within.

indent_width.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

trailing_comma.description: Whether to emit a trailing comma in multi-line comma-separated lists.
